exam: APPSC Degree Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
q: Who was the Chairman of the committee for Draft National Education Policy?
explanation: Dr K. Kasturirangan chaired the committee for the Draft National Education Policy (2019) that led to NEP 2020; Vasudha Kamat and M.K. Sridhar were members.

exam: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
q: The Secondary Education Commission of 1952-53 was also called as:
explanation: The Secondary Education Commission (1952-53) was chaired by A. Lakshmanaswami Mudaliar, so it is called the Mudaliar Commission.

exam: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
q: "Destiny of India is being shaped in the classroom". This is stated in which commission?
explanation: 'The destiny of India is now being shaped in her classrooms' is the opening sentence of the Education Commission (Kothari Commission, 1964-66) report.

exam: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
q: Vocationalization of education in India was first recommended by:
explanation: The Mudaliar (Secondary Education) Commission, 1952-53, recommended diversified courses and multipurpose schools, the usual answer for the first recommendation of vocationalisation; Kothari (1964-66) took it further.
